preamble: Middle Chinese [dʒ] (崇 group) became the fricative [ʂ] in the oblique tones in Mandarin, via spirantization of the devoiced affricate.

examples.from: Middle Chinese 仕 dzrjiX 'serve as official'

sources: Pulleyblank, E. G. (1984). Middle Chinese: A Study in Historical Phonology. University of British Columbia Press.
Norman, J. (1988). Chinese. Cambridge University Press.
